antipatterns.name: SKIP_QA_FOR_INFRASTRUCTURE
antipatterns.description: Skipping visual QA testing for 'infrastructure' or 'scaffold' features
antipatterns.prevention: ALL features require step-05a-qa, even scaffolds. Visual verification catches integration issues.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Initially skipped visual testing assuming scaffold didn't need it
antipatterns.lesson: Even scaffolds need browser verification to confirm frontend-backend integration works

antipatterns.name: MANUAL_LEARNING_OUTPUT
antipatterns.description: Writing superficial 09-learn.md without updating actual learning system files
antipatterns.prevention: Step-09-learn MUST update: metrics.json, patterns.json, antipatterns.json in .nomos/learning/
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Created output file but didn't update learning infrastructure
antipatterns.lesson: Learning extraction requires updating JSON files, not just markdown

antipatterns.name: SKIP_CLEANUP_PROMPT
antipatterns.description: Not asking user about worktree cleanup when auto_mode=false
antipatterns.prevention: When cleanup_mode=false AND auto_mode=false, MUST use AskUserQuestion for cleanup decision
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Worktree left behind without asking user preference
antipatterns.lesson: Follow step-08-merge.md cleanup protocol exactly

antipatterns.name: RELATIVE_DATABASE_URL
antipatterns.description: Using relative path without file: prefix in DATABASE_URL causes CWD-dependent failures
antipatterns.prevention: Always use absolute paths with file: prefix in DATABASE_URL: file:/absolute/path/to/db.sqlite
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: DATABASE_URL=.nomos/nomos.db missing file: prefix and using relative path. @libsql/client requires file: prefix. Relative paths resolve from CWD which varies in monorepo.
antipatterns.lesson: In worktree .env setup: 1) Use WORKTREE_ROOT=$(pwd) to get absolute path, 2) Use file:${WORKTREE_ROOT}/.nomos/nomos.db format
antipatterns.fix_applied: step-00-init.md now uses absolute paths with file: prefix

antipatterns.name: DUAL_ENV_LOADING
antipatterns.description: drizzle.config.ts and packages/env load .env from different locations causing mismatches
antipatterns.prevention: drizzle.config.ts now tries multiple paths: CWD, apps/server, packages/db relative. Validation added for DATABASE_URL format.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: drizzle.config.ts hardcoded ../../apps/server/.env while packages/env loaded from CWD
antipatterns.lesson: Env loading in monorepos must handle multiple execution contexts (root, package dir, worktree)
antipatterns.fix_applied: drizzle.config.ts now tries multiple paths and validates DATABASE_URL format

antipatterns.name: BIOME_BEFORE_COMMIT
antipatterns.description: Not running Biome format check before committing leads to extra chore commits
antipatterns.prevention: Run 'bunx biome check . --write --unsafe' before committing feature code, or integrate into pre-commit hook
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: 14 Biome formatting fixes needed after initial commit, requiring a separate chore commit
antipatterns.lesson: Always format before the first commit to keep commit history clean (1 feat commit instead of feat + chore)

antipatterns.name: MISSING_DEPENDENCY_INSTALL
antipatterns.description: Using imports in code without verifying package is installed in package.json
antipatterns.prevention: After adding ANY new import, verify package exists in package.json. Run 'bun install' and test 'bun run dev' before marking feature complete.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: zustand was imported in apps/web/src/store/index.ts but never installed. Dev server crashed with 'Failed to resolve import zustand'.
antipatterns.lesson: ALWAYS: 1) Check if import is from external package, 2) Verify package.json has dependency, 3) Run 'bun add <pkg>' if missing, 4) Test dev server starts before completing feature
antipatterns.detection: Run 'bun run dev' and check for 'Failed to resolve import' errors in browser console

antipatterns.name: LOCAL_TYPE_DUPLICATION
antipatterns.description: Defining API response types (FeatureFromAPI) locally in components instead of importing from shared @nomos-ai/types package
antipatterns.prevention: All API-facing types must be defined in @nomos-ai/types or @nomos-ai/db and imported, not redefined in components. This prevents divergence between frontend and backend type definitions.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: feature-form.tsx defined local FeatureFromAPI type with id, title, category, etc. instead of importing from @nomos-ai/db/schema or creating FeatureSelect in @nomos-ai/types.
antipatterns.lesson: Source of truth for entity shapes must be single location (database schema or shared package). Frontend should import and extend, never redefine.
antipatterns.fix_approach: Create FeatureSelect export in packages/db/src/schema/features.ts using getTableColumns(features), export from @nomos-ai/db. Import in components as: import { type FeatureSelect } from "@nomos-ai/db";
antipatterns.estimated_impact: MEDIUM - inconsistency risk if entity shape changes in API but frontend type diverges

antipatterns.name: NON_FUNCTIONAL_OWNERSHIP_FILTERING
antipatterns.description: Implemented ownership-based event filtering logic (checking userId in message payloads) without actual event payloads containing userId. Creates dead code and confusion about filtering model.
antipatterns.prevention: For single-user desktop app, keep all-authenticated-users-subscribe-all model. Only add per-event filtering if: (1) multi-user backend sends userId in payload AND (2) business requirement demands it.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: F034 iterations 1-2 included ownership checks for userId in WsServerMessage.payload, but terminal:output and feature:* events never included userId. Simplified in iteration 3.
antipatterns.lesson: Avoid filtering logic without supporting data. Single-user desktop app has simpler auth model: authenticate connection, allow all subscriptions.
antipatterns.fix_applied: Removed userId filtering, kept authenticate-on-upgrade requirement

antipatterns.name: COMPONENT_DUPLICATION_BEFORE_EXTRACTION
antipatterns.description: Component-like logic duplicated across files (ThinkingBlock rendering in multiple places) instead of extracted to shared component immediately
antipatterns.prevention: During Phase 3 iteration 1, identify duplicated JSX patterns. Move to shared component before iteration 2. Extract: component structure + styling + state together.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: ThinkingBlock logic appeared in multiple iterations before extraction. Cost: +1 iteration.
antipatterns.lesson: In React features, identify display patterns (collapsible sections, formatted blocks) early and extract to dedicated component. Reduces iteration count and improves maintainability.

antipatterns.name: HARDCODED_PROJECTID_IN_DIALOG
antipatterns.description: Dialog mutation parameters included hardcoded projectId instead of extracting from feature prop
antipatterns.prevention: Always thread required context properties (projectId, featureId) as props through dialog hierarchy. Extract from parent feature object and pass to mutation explicitly.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: First iteration hardcoded projectId = "hardcoded-id" in handleConfirm instead of using feature.projectId
antipatterns.lesson: Dialog components working with domain objects must extract IDs and context from props, never hardcode. Prevents runtime failures when feature context changes.
antipatterns.fix_applied: Updated mutation calls: createSession({ featureId: feature.id, projectId: feature.projectId, ... })

antipatterns.name: VALID_TRANSITIONS_DUPLICATION_IN_COMPONENTS
antipatterns.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine definition duplicated in component files instead of imported from single source (backend router)
antipatterns.prevention: Define VALID_TRANSITIONS once in backend router. For client-side validation before mutations, export from @nomos-ai/types, query via API, or accept server as source of truth.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Second iteration had VALID_TRANSITIONS defined in both feature-detail-panel.tsx and start-execution-dialog.tsx. If state machine changes, must update 3 places.
antipatterns.lesson: State machines are business logic—single source of truth in backend. Frontend can reference for UX validation but should not own copies.
antipatterns.fix_applied: Removed frontend VALID_TRANSITIONS duplication. Server enforces transitions; client shows toast on mutation error.

antipatterns.name: MUTATION_ORDER_DEPENDENCIES_WITHOUT_ERROR_HANDLING
antipatterns.description: Sequential mutations without proper error boundaries create orphaned state if intermediate mutation fails
antipatterns.prevention: For any sequential mutation chain, wrap in try/catch with descriptive error messages. Consider compensating transactions or idempotent operation sequencing.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: handleConfirm chained createSession -> updateStatus -> sendMessage without try/catch. If updateStatus fails after session created, session orphaned.
antipatterns.lesson: Multi-step workflows need error recovery planning. MVP acceptable with caveat, but document limitation and plan compensation logic for v2.
antipatterns.fix_applied: Wrapped in try/catch with specific toast message for which mutation failed. Documented as MVP limitation in comments.

antipatterns.name: PARTIAL_AUTH_FIX
antipatterns.description: Applying authorization fixes to some routers but not others. F224 fixed feature + project routers but left 7 other routers unprotected.
antipatterns.prevention: When fixing cross-cutting concerns (auth, validation, logging), enumerate ALL affected surfaces first. Create checklist of every router/endpoint. Verify fix covers 100% before marking complete.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Session, agent, learning, settings, notifications, worktree routers missing userId checks while feature + project routers are properly secured
antipatterns.lesson: Creates false sense of security — feature appears fixed but most endpoints remain vulnerable. Cross-cutting fixes must be exhaustive.

antipatterns.name: ANONYMOUS_WEBSOCKET_FALLBACK
antipatterns.description: WebSocket auth that falls back to 'anonymous' on failure instead of rejecting the connection
antipatterns.prevention: WebSocket upgrade handlers must reject connection on auth failure. Never default to anonymous. Use ws.close(4401, 'Unauthorized') pattern.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: extractWsUserId defaults to 'anonymous' when session extraction fails
antipatterns.lesson: Unauthenticated clients can establish persistent connections and receive all broadcast events. Auth failures should be hard failures.

antipatterns.name: HARDCODED_PERMISSION_BYPASS
antipatterns.description: SDK/provider code that hardcodes permissionMode to bypassPermissions regardless of user configuration
antipatterns.prevention: Provider/SDK wrappers must pass through user-configured permission settings. Never hardcode bypass. Default to most restrictive mode.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: ClaudeProvider always sets bypassPermissions:true in SDK options
antipatterns.lesson: Agent runs with full filesystem access even when user configured restricted permissions. Violates principle of least privilege.

antipatterns.name: TEST_RUNNER_MISMATCH
antipatterns.description: Tests written for one test runner (bun:test) but CI configured for another (vitest). Tests exist but never execute.
antipatterns.prevention: Standardize on one test runner across the monorepo. Verify test scripts in package.json match import statements. CI must fail if zero tests run.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: packages/types tests use bun:test imports but vitest is the configured runner
antipatterns.lesson: Broken tests go undetected, giving false confidence in code quality. Invisible tests are worse than no tests.

antipatterns.name: WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH
antipatterns.description: Server and client WebSocket handlers use different message type strings and payload structures. No shared type definition enforces consistency.
antipatterns.prevention: Define shared WebSocket message types in packages/types. Both server and client import and use the same type.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Server sends { type: output, data } but client expects { type: terminal:output, payload: { data } }
antipatterns.lesson: Always use shared types for WebSocket message protocols. Without a shared contract, mismatches are invisible at compile time.

antipatterns.name: INCONSISTENT_AUTHORIZATION_WITHIN_ROUTER
antipatterns.description: Some endpoints in a single router check ownership while others in the same router skip checks. Creates false sense of security.
antipatterns.prevention: Apply authorization checks at the router middleware level, not per-endpoint. Use a shared auth guard.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: notifications.ts: list/countUnread check ownership, markRead/dismiss accept any ID
antipatterns.lesson: When fixing auth, audit ALL endpoints in the affected router, not just the reported ones.

antipatterns.name: GLOBAL_FETCH_THEN_FILTER
antipatterns.description: Fetching all records with findAll() then filtering in the handler instead of querying with a WHERE clause.
antipatterns.prevention: Add findByUser() or findByProject() methods to repositories. Filter at the database query level.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: service.listSessions() returns ALL sessions, router filters by userId after fetch
antipatterns.lesson: Always push filtering to the database layer. Application-level filtering is inefficient and temporarily exposes data.
